name: qrcode-generation-platform
description: Local-first QR code generation web application with Angular and Node.js.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend -- --runInBand && npm test --prefix frontend -- --watch=false --browsers=ChromeHeadless
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
